cases.purpose: Exercise clean formatting, rejection without mutation, and forced and ordinary rewrites of an existing swap signature on a private loop device.
cases.comparison: Raw status, stdout and stderr (only Bash location prefix removed), plus complete-device digest after every operation; setup or teardown failure is an error.
cases.script:
set -u
export LC_ALL=C
/usr/bin/truncate -s 1048576 /tmp/mkswap-rewrite.img || exit 90
d=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show /tmp/mkswap-rewrite.img) || exit 91
cleanup() { /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || exit 92; }
trap cleanup EXIT
U=11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555
run() {
  local name=$1 expected=$2 rc=0; shift 2
  "$@" >/tmp/mkswap.out 2>/tmp/mkswap.err || rc=$?
  printf '%s status=%s out=' "$name" "$rc"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' </tmp/mkswap.out
  printf ' err='; /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' /tmp/mkswap.err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'
  printf ' sha='; /usr/bin/sha256sum < "$d"
  [[ $rc == "$expected" ]] || exit 93
}
run clean 0 mkswap -U "$U" -L rootc "$d"
before=$(/usr/bin/sha256sum < "$d")
run reject 1 mkswap -U "$U" -L rootc "$d" 4096
[[ $(/usr/bin/sha256sum < "$d") == "$before" ]] || exit 94
run force 0 mkswap -f -U "$U" -L rootc "$d" 4096
run smaller 0 mkswap -U "$U" -L rootc "$d" 512
